audits.selchp_prior_status: Part81 had screened SELCHP because an explicit 2024 PI substance table was not obtained at that time. The current page now exposes an explicit target-year PI table, so six rows can be promoted to candidate-only without using APR values as substitutes.
audits.duplicate_policy: Fresh repository searches for NP3738SY with 354284000, 190858000, 354367, 22192, 22920 and 10317 returned zero promoted matches before Part102.
audits.identity_policy: Environment Agency effective register, official permit variation and Companies House independently align permit NP3738SY, company 02489384 and SELCHP.
audits.method_policy: Calculated/Measured labels are retained exactly as source reporting methods; project measured_emission_rows remains zero until direct raw and downstream gates pass.
audits.component_policy: Renewable-source CO2 is a subset/component and is never added to total CO2.
audits.dual_year_quality_policy: Integra North N2O is explicitly 2025-only and remains excluded; Leeds and Severnside current tables confirm prior retained 2024 core-gas rows without new additions.
audits.direct_raw_policy: Official 2024 PI resource route is known but direct facility raw rows are not consumed in this runtime; confidence remains capped at 98.
audits.zero_policy: Blank, later-year, particulate, trace-metal and zero-looking values are never moved into 2024 or converted into missing-zero candidates.

quality.confidence_policy: 98 maximum until a direct Environment Agency PI or Defra UK PRTR raw row is actually read and matched to facility, year, medium, pollutant, value and method.
